name: KOI_STUDIO
description: KOI Studio is a student-created Angular website for fans of romance anime and manga, offering curated recommendations, reviews, and a platform to share favorite titles. It’s designed to be interactive, visually appealing, and community-driven.

paragraphs: KOI Studio is a website created by the students of WD‑302 for fans of romance anime and manga. While we may be a small team of passionate creators, we strive to bring you the best recommendations, anime, and manga in the romance genre.

KOI Studio provides a curated collection of romance anime and manga, recommendations, and reviews. The website is designed to engage the community, encourage sharing of favorite titles, and showcase student web development skills using Angular.
The goal is to provide a fun, interactive, and visually appealing website for romance anime enthusiasts while demonstrating professional frontend development practices.
